name: SEO-Friendly Filename Generator
description: Turn any text into a clean, SEO-friendly filename or URL slug — lowercase, separator options, special-character stripping and instant copy.
body:
Your SEO-friendly name will appear here.

Example conversions
howto: Paste or type the text you want to convert — a title, filename or phrase.
Adjust the options: lowercase, strip special characters and choose a separator (hyphen, underscore or none).
The result updates instantly in the panel.
Click Copy result to copy the clean filename or slug.
Scroll the examples panel to see how different inputs are converted.
features: Automatic removal of special characters and double separators
Handles accented characters (é → e, ñ → n, etc.)

faq.a: Short, lowercase names with hyphens or underscores between words, no spaces, and no special characters. Search engines and file systems both handle these reliably and they describe the content at a glance.

faq.q: Hyphen or underscore — which should I use?
faq.a: For URLs, hyphens are the standard — Google treats them as word separators. Underscores are common for file names on some platforms. The tool lets you choose either.

faq.q: Does this rename my files for me?
faq.a: No — it generates the clean name. To rename actual files in bulk, use the Batch File Renamer tool.

faq.q: Will this work for non-English text?
faq.a: Basic Latin accents are converted to their plain letters. Characters outside the Latin alphabet are kept only if they are alphanumeric; everything else is stripped or converted to the separator.
